title: Listening for Main Ideas and Details
introduction: Understand short spoken messages with support from a partner.
definition: Understand short spoken messages with support from a partner.
rules: Ask a partner to read the text aloud while you look away.
Listen for the main idea first, then the needed detail; ask for repetition if needed.

examples.question: Listen: On Saturday, Aina reads comics at home. Which day?
steps: Listen for the time phrase at the beginning.

examples.question: Listen: Ben puts his blue hat in the bag. What colour is it?
steps: Listen for the colour before hat.

exercises.question: Listen: On Saturday, Aina reads comics at home. Which day?
exercises.solution: Listen for the time phrase at the beginning.

exercises.question: Listen: Ben puts his blue hat in the bag. What colour is it?
exercises.solution: Listen for the colour before hat.

exercises.question: Listen: Mei goes to the beach with her sister. Who goes with her?
exercises.solution: The phrase after with names her companion.

exercises.question: Listen: Ravi has a new bike. He rides it after school. What is the message about? (a bike or a bus)
Listen: The robot can turn and wave. What does it do after turning?
exercises.solution: Listen for the action following and.

exercises.question: Listen: The library closes at four. When does it close? (write the number in words)
exercises.solution: Listen for the number after at.

summary: Understand short spoken messages with support from a partner. Ask a partner to read the text aloud while you look away.
